name: European long distance path E1 - part Denmark
description_md:
European long distance path E1 - part Denmark is a waymarked hiking route in DK. It covers 383.4 km with 3317 m of ascent and 3296 m of descent.

The itinerary is signposted as E1 and forms part of an international waymarked hiking network. Difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent, requiring about 105 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Along the way, the path passes Gorms Mound within 100 m, Aarhus within 200 m, and the Diocese of Århus within 600 m.
